repos_data.description: Open-source, self-hosted file-processing tool. Convert, compress, OCR, transcribe & run local AI across image, video, audio, PDF & documents, via UI, REST API & pipelines. Your files never leave your network.

⌘⌘ - A lightweight, native macOS screenshot tool that lives in your menu bar. Double-tap ⌘ Command to capture any region of your screen — instantly copied to clipboard, or annotate first with pen and mosaic tools.
easy to use mac osx image editing application for the rest of us
MS Paint for the Mac. Mark up screenshots or paint from scratch. The drawing engine ships as PaintKit, a UI-free Swift package with no dependencies that supports macOS 12 and iOS 15 and later.
